### Sin Will Find You Out
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/sin-will-find-you-out
Passage: Numbers 32:23
Points:
- The sin Moses warned about was the sin of inaction—settling into comfort while brethren faced battle.
- Neglecting God's mission harms the community by discouraging others and ultimately sins against the Lord.
- Sins of omission and secret sins will inevitably catch up to the sinner, as nothing escapes God's notice.
- Christ hunted down sin by bearing its full penalty and wrath on the cross for all who believe.
- Believers are forgiven to pursue holiness and actively engage alongside their spiritual family in God's mission.

### Bible Pathway - February 27
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-27-2013.html
Passage: Numbers 32
Points:
- Settling east of the Jordan made financial sense for livestock, but it was a spiritual compromise.
- Choosing land based on convenience rather than God's full promise weakened the tribes' spiritual focus and community unity.
- Christians fall into a similar trap when material gain or social advantages dictate their life choices.
- Prioritizing temporal comfort over corporate worship and God's presence leads to spiritual drift.
- True gain is found in wholehearted obedience and contentment with God's will.
